**Screenshot of the trade**
A screenshot of the trade window helps a lot, especially when an item was read wrong.

**Debug capture (for wrong items or quantities)**
1. Turn on Settings > Capture > Save debug captures
2. Scan the trade again
3. Open the folder (the "Open folder" link next to the setting) and attach the newest folder as a zip

**Log**
Attach `%LOCALAPPDATA%\MM2TradeOverlay\log.txt`.
